# libchdr

PS2 optical disc reads use the C decoder and bundled codecs from [libchdr v0.3.0](https://github.com/rtissera/libchdr/releases/tag/v0.3.0). The upstream source archive has SHA-256 `313f6bf5537e2494daa3daa8a931a2536fc4f2b8312c07e3c3d5324d2052fa20`. The local CMake target builds the portable decoder into the launcher and runtimes. Block CRC verification is enabled.
